Legend

The Ruthless Seven have sent a powerful demonic being to the Plains Of Havoc. Do you have what it takes to stop it?

Location

Plains of Havoc

Dangers

Banshees, Betrayed Wraiths, Blightwalker, Bonebeasts, Braindeaths, Dark Torturer, Demon, Giant Spiders, Grim Reaper, Hand of Cursed Fate, Liches, Undead Dragon and Vampires.

Reward

Herbicide achievement, ability to obtain the Demon Outfits' second addon and one out of four available items: Demon Legs, Rainbow Shield, Spellbook of Ancient Arcana or Thorn Spitter

History

Before the Summer Update 2009, the method to start this quest was rather different, as it did not require a Holy Icon but rather stepping on specific tiles. This method was never completely understood (even though the quest was completed then), and then the quest was modified to the current state. There was also a short period after the quest was initially introduced during which access to the Demon Oak was apparently much easier (and not as rare) than it was intended, so a patch was released to supposedly fix this.

Requirements

  • A Holy Icon.
  • An Axe.

Method

First, you need to go to the Plains of Havoc and search for "the infested area" (here (32717, 32351, 7)). It is surrounded by a lot of Dead Trees, east of Dark Cathedral and north of the vampire's house. There you will find a 1 sqm corridor that leads into the center (there is no Gate Of Expertise but you do need to be level 120 or above to be eligible for entry). If you have the Holy Icon with you, you will be teleported into the infested area.

Upon entering the area you will receive this event message:

It seems that you have discovered an 'Ultimate Challenge'

However, once inside the infested area you must then leave and speak with Oldrak in the Plains of Havoc Temple who will then make you a Hallowed Axe after bringing him a normal Axe and 1,000 gp.

Once you have acquired the Hallowed Axe return to the Demon Oak and start to attack its 4 most vulnerable points:

  1. The left spiked ball
  2. The bird
  3. The face of the tree
  4. The right spiked ball

Attacking these four points will anger the Demon Oak and cause him to summon monsters. Every time you attack one of the points, you will lose 300 hitpoints (Earth Damage). Once attacking the four points you will have to keep attacking that same area until it is "Dead" (it will "puff smoke"). Depending on which order you choose to do the four points the demon oak summons different monsters.

Here's the pattern:

  • Left spiked ball:
    • 5th hit = 3x Braindeaths + 1x Bonebeast
    • 10th hit = 2x Betrayed Wraiths
  • Bird:
    • 5th hit = 3x Liches
    • 10th hit = 1x Dark Torturer + 1x Blightwalker
  • Right spiked ball:
    • 5th hit = 3x Banshees
    • 10th hit = 1x Grim Reaper
  • The face of the tree:
    • 5th hit = 2x Giant Spiders + 1x Lich
    • 10th hit = 1x Undead Dragon + 1x Hand of Cursed Fate

For hits 1-4 and 6-9 it's random if the demon oak summons nothing or 4x bonebeasts.

The 10th hit on the last of the four points is always 1x Demon instead of what should've spawned, i.e. if you do the face last you get the Demon instead of the Undead Dragon and the Hand of Cursed Fate, and if you do the left spiked ball last you get the Demon instead of the two Betrayed Wraiths and so on.

Use Hallowed axe in these areas

Once the tree is 100% dead, you may leave again. Upon exiting the area you will receive the Herbicide achievement and the following message:

Tell Oldrak about your great victory against the demon oak.

Thus, speak to Oldrak again to tell him you have defeated the Demon Oak. Once this is done, go to a grave stone which is located south of the infected area with the name of "Yesim Adeit" (Which can be read as "Yes I made it"), here (32710, 32398, 7). Use the Grave Stone (you may have to remove a Star Herb that spawns on top of it) to enter the rewards room and choose your reward.

Additionally, you are now eligible of obtaining second addon of Demon Outfits.

Transcripts

Player: Hi
Oldrak: Welcome Player! Only rarely I can welcome visitors these days.
Player: Demon Oak
Oldrak: A demon oak?!? <mumbles some blessings> May the gods be on our side. You'll need a hallowed axe to harm that tree. Bring me a simple 'axe' and I'll prepare it for you.
Player: Axe
Oldrak: Ahh, you've got an axe. Very good. I can make a hallowed axe out of it. It will cost you... er... a donation of 1,000 gold. Alright?
Player: Yes
Oldrak: Let's see....<mumbles a prayer>....here we go. The blessing on this axe will be absorbed by all the demonic energy around here. I presume it will not last very long, so better hurry. Actually, I can refresh the blessing as often as you like.

Oldrak: You chopped down the demon oak?!? Unbelievable!! Let's hope it doesn't come back. As long as evil is still existent in the soil of the plains, it won't be over. Still, the demons suffered a setback, that's for sure. ...
Oldrak: For your brave action, I tell you a secret which has been kept for many many years. There is an old house south of the location where you found the demon oak. There should be a grave with the name 'Yesim Adeit' somewhere close by. ...
